name: gplanchat/durable-laravel
description: Laravel integration for gplanchat/durable — binds the four storage ports from one published config file

suggest.illuminate/console: Required by durable:temporal-worker, the only command this package adds. Every Laravel application already has it; it is suggested so that it stays out of a monorepo graph that still tests the Symfony 6.4 line.
suggest.gplanchat/durable-bridge-temporal: Required by the "temporal" backend: the gRPC driver for a Temporal cluster. Suggested rather than required because it installs five Symfony components a Laravel application never loads.
